decisive_items: Demonstrated inferior displacement of the cerebellar tonsils
Ventral cervicothoracic epidural CSF collection extending from the mid cervical spine to mid thoracic level
response.rationale: Inferior tonsillar displacement is the hallmark of Chiari malformation, directly supported. The epidural CSF collection is more consistent with CSF leak (not syringomyelia), but given the candidate set, Chiari is the best fit; R1 misinterprets the collection as syringomyelia.

rejected.why: Epidural CSF collection is not syringomyelia; it suggests CSF leak, which is not the provided label.
